an4.274:1.1: rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā
an4.274:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
an4.274:1.4: vedanāsu … cittesu … dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
an4.274:1.5: rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbāti.
